moments.selftext: Just got this clip from a follower showing their @Tesla avoiding a collision recently on the highway while on FSD (Supervised) V14. Here are all the angles. Self-Driving data at top:
top_comments: Not only is Tesla FSD avoiding an accident, but it didn’t cause another one. A typical human driver would have overcorrected, reacted late, or done the wrong thing. FSD is an expert driver that handles emergencies really well.
Takes some serious balls not to disengage. It’s best not to.

We need everyone on FSD asap so these accidents dont happen in the first place.  

Incredible that we're so slow to adopt this life saving tech.  Its frustrating as hell.
